task.title: To set a style for a segment in a template

step.cmd: Open Microsoft Word and log in to X-Author for Contracts Advanced.
From the Contracts pane, click the Home icon () and select Templates.
In the Templates pane, go to Work tab, click theDropdown icon ()and select Segments.
Highlight a block of text in your template and click Style. This opens the Select Styles dialog box that lists custom styles.
Select a custom style or select the Show template styles checkbox and select a style.
Click Save. The segment is added as Segment Regular to the segments list in the Segment pane. Selecting the segment name from the list highlights that segment in the template document.
